headlines.title: Bitcoin's biggest weekly gain ever, is BTC ready to roar back?
headlines.summary: Scott Melker discusses the latest crypto-related headlines, including bitcoin's (BTC-USD) largest weekly dollar gain ever, Strategy  (MSTR) raises $2 billion while adding zero bitcoin, and much more. "The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker" airs every day at 12:00 p.m. Tune in for your daily dose of all things crypto. Make sure to also check out Yahoo Finance's new crypto hub to find the latest crypto-related news.

headlines.title: Strategy raises $2B last week through common stock sale
headlines.summary: Strategy raised about $2 billion last week and created a new "USD Cash" pool, giving it $6.69 billion in dollar liquidity that can be used to buy more bitcoin, repurchase shares, or repay debt. The company left its 840,447 BTC untouched for a second straight week. CoinDesk's Uyen Truong hosts "CoinDesk Daily.

headlines.title: Strategy Didn’t Buy Bitcoin as Cryptos Surged, but It Wasn’t Sitting Still
headlines.summary: Strategy raised $2 billion through stock sales last week, boosting its cash reserves and creating a new liquidity pool as Bitcoin rallied.

headlines.title: Strive Jumps 5% as CEO Declares the Bitcoin Bear Market Over, Strategy and Bitmine Rise 3%
headlines.summary: Strive's CEO just called the Bitcoin bear market dead, insiders are buying shares, and treasury stocks are surging while miners slide. Whether this breakout holds or fades by the close could determine which side of that divide you want to be on.

headlines.title: MSTR Stock Gains After Strategy Sets Up $1.59B ‘USD Cash’ Pool With Bitcoin Nearing $79K
headlines.summary: The new pool is separate from the company’s $5.10 billion USD Reserve, which remains focused on preferred dividends and interest on debt.

description: Strategy Inc, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a bitcoin treasury company in the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and internationally. It offers investors varying degrees of economic exposure to Bitcoin by offering a range of securities, including equity and fixed income instruments. The company also provides AI-powered enterprise analytics software, including Strategy One, which provides non-technical users with the ability to directly access novel and actionable insights for decision-making. In addition, the company provides Strategy Mosaic, a universal intelligence layer that offers enterprises with consistent definitions and governance across data sources, regardless of where that data resides or which tools access it. The company was formerly known as MicroStrategy Incorporated and changed its name to Strategy Inc in August 2025. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia.
